summary: Iteration 14 verifies the clearer capture waiting state (frontend-only). (1) Static code review of /app/frontend/app/capture.tsx (186 lines): `busy` is set to true synchronously at the top of shoot() (line 64) BEFORE the slow takePictureAsync call so the overlay appears immediately; the overlay <View testID='capture-busy'> (lines 142-152) is the LAST child of the root <View> so it stacks on top of top bar, viewport AND bottom bar — therefore it covers the shutter, library and Files buttons; the shutter also has a second guard `disabled={!perm?.granted || busy}` (line 135) plus an in-handler early return `if (busy) return;` (line 63), so double-shoot is impossible. State reset: send() uses try/finally that clears busy+frozen+progress even on error (lines 55-59); shoot() catches errors from takePictureAsync and resets busy+frozen (lines 71-75). Overlay content matches the spec: a full-screen Image({uri:frozen}) with blurRadius=18 + resizeMode='cover' underneath, a rgba(0,0,0,0.65) dim layer, a large ActivityIndicator, 'Vänta …' at fontSize 30 fontWeight 800 (styles.busyTitle line 161), and a subtitle that reads 'Skickar bild {i} av {n}' when progress.n>1, 'Skickar bilden till CopyThat' when a single file, 'Tar bilden' before progress is set (line 149). styles.busy uses position:absolute top/left/right/bottom 0 (line 159) so the overlay truly covers the whole screen incl. shutter. Library + Files flows reach the same overlay because they call send() which sets busy=true (line 44). (2) iOS bundle compiles: GET http://localhost:3000/node_modules/expo-router/entry.bundle?platform=ios&dev=true&hot=false&lazy=true&transform.engine=hermes&transform.routerRoot=app -> 200 (6,504,854 bytes); bundle contains `capture-busy`, `styles.busyTitle` with children `V\xE4nta \u2026` ('Vänta …'), 'Tar bilden', 'Skickar bilden till CopyThat', and the template literal `Skickar bild ${progress.i} av ${progress.n}` — all three subtitle variants are present. (3) Web smoke 390x844: login test@copythat.app / 246810 succeeds -> /archive; direct navigation to /capture?doc=nonexistent renders WITHOUT red-screen / no PAGEERROR / no Uncaught/ReferenceError/TypeError; shows the camera-permission variant ('Fotografera ditt studiematerial' + 'Tillåt kamera' button) because web has no camera grant yet — this is expected per the request. All relevant testIDs are present and resolved on the DOM: capture-close=1, capture-done=1, capture-shutter=1, capture-busy=0 (correctly absent while not busy). Only pre-login console error observed is the expected 401 on /api/me before the session cookie is set. Camera is native-only, so the real freeze/blur/'Vänta …' overlay must still be verified by the user on an iPhone.
critical_code_review_comments: capture.tsx:64 — setBusy(true) is called synchronously BEFORE `await cam.current?.takePictureAsync(...)`, which is exactly what the spec requires so the overlay appears while the photo is being taken (not just during the upload). Good.

capture.tsx:142-152 — overlay rendered as last child of the root View so z-order places it over the bottom bar (shutter+library+files) and the top bar; combined with position:absolute top/left/right/bottom 0 (styles.busy) it fully blocks interactions.
capture.tsx:135 + :63 — shutter has double protection against double-tap while busy: `disabled` prop AND an in-handler `if (busy) return`. Correct.

capture.tsx:55-59 — send()'s finally always clears busy/frozen/progress; shoot()'s catch (71-75) resets busy/frozen before send() is called. State is never stuck. Note: progress is left null in the shoot-error path, which is already the state so no leak.
capture.tsx:149 — subtitle logic `progress ? (progress.n > 1 ? 'Skickar bild X av N' : 'Skickar bilden till CopyThat') : 'Tar bilden'` matches the three states described in the request.

capture.tsx:144 — Image blurRadius={18} + resizeMode='cover' + StyleSheet.absoluteFill is the correct React Native way to show a full-bleed blurred preview of the just-taken photo. iOS honours blurRadius natively on <Image>.

Minor (not blocking): the library and Files Pressables (:132 and :138) have accessibilityLabel but no testID. Not needed for this change, but adding `testID="capture-library"` / `testID="capture-files"` would make future automation easier.

Minor: the `library` and Files handlers both call send() which flips busy inside — there is a <100 ms window between the picker closing and send() setting busy where the shutter is still enabled; in practice imperceptible because iOS picker dismissal animation covers it. Not worth fixing.

success_rate.frontend: code review OK + iOS bundle 200 OK + web smoke renders without red-screen on /capture?doc=…

context_for_next_testing_agent: Login: test@copythat.app / 246810. The capture overlay cannot be exercised on web because web has no camera permission and takePictureAsync is a no-op there — the 'capture-busy' testID will only appear during an actual shoot / library / Files upload on iOS. For web regression it is enough to assert /capture?doc=… renders the permission UI and that capture-close / capture-done / capture-shutter resolve. On iPhone, verify: (a) after tapping the shutter the overlay appears INSTANTLY (before the photo is produced) showing 'Vänta …' + 'Tar bilden'; (b) once the photo is captured the overlay shows the blurred frozen photo with 'Skickar bilden till CopyThat'; (c) multi-select from library shows 'Skickar bild i av n'; (d) overlay disappears after upload completes or an error toast appears; (e) shutter cannot be double-tapped while busy.
